headline: OTP Group is buying the remaining state-owned shares of Ipoteka bank
summary: OTP Group is acquiring the remaining state-held stake of about 17.5% in Ipoteka Bank. The deal would lift the Hungarian group's holding in the Uzbek lender to 90.4%.
why: OTP Group is a Central and Eastern European banking group headquartered in Budapest, with operations across several emerging markets. Stake changes in its subsidiaries affect its regional earnings footprint.

impacts.name: OTP Group
impacts.why: OTP Group would increase its ownership of Ipoteka Bank to 90.4%.
